notes: By default, お茶 refers to Japanese green tea (hot or cold) or barley tea (麦茶), though it can refer to tea in general. Black tea is usually called 紅茶 (kōcha).
The お at the beginning is a polite prefix that has become standard; bare 茶 (cha) is rarely used on its own in conversation.

senses.definition: A drink made from tea leaves (or roasted grains), especially Japanese green tea.
